how: A member supplies both the proposed Cal mark and the opening call for people to build it.

Members negotiate shared representation by objecting to a band-specific addition and redirecting the proposer toward maintenance.
Members report active construction and the colour and position of the part they are placing.
Guideline requests, coordinates, and template corrections coordinate work while allowing the existing C to constrain revisions.
A defence-script appeal and an earlier hand-made claim leave actual script execution unobserved.
Members explicitly shift toward maintenance and call people to repair an attacked logo.
Neighbours negotiate a truce and blue surroundings while participants contest whether permission covers later additions.

Another university's request for help receives a refusal because the responder cannot spare pixels.
Participants request border repair and describe helping the host as an expected return for space.
A truce request and an expectation of reciprocal defence do not establish a concluded alliance or coalition membership.
Proposals call for overtaking another university's logo, replacing a school mark, and striking a sleeping host.
Attack proposals and internal rebuttal do not establish reciprocal taunting, rival-thread flooding, or a sustained contest conducted with another room.
Members judge the corner fight unwinnable when proposing another restart.
A consumed bear, an imposed move, and an unwinnable corner fight lead into proposals and announcements for restarting elsewhere.
Participants announce completion, credit pixel spenders, and describe pride and the pleasure of painting together.
Participants report making the final canvas and mourn the ended event without establishing the contents of the linked image.

Sharing the current local April Fools article and collecting earlier jokes places playful host conduct alongside the canvas effort.
Moderator plan announcements and a mock ban threat cannot test the model's cross-room prevalence claim or establish a complete local command structure.
The selected rival-replacement passage omits its motive and the Stanford joke omits a canvas target, leaving the proposed prior-rivalry mechanism unresolved.
A permission question and refusal to make personal entreaties do not explicitly dispute an envoy's right to bind all placers.
Reporting a final version and mourning closure do not show a dispute over cleaning or retaining a historical version.
The coded target proposal and ambiguous school joke cannot establish that a prior quarrel caused canvas action.
Members carry school belonging into the build by naming Cal coordinates Bear Territory.
The Stanford-shills joke carries school-directed language without identifying the alleged attack as canvas conduct.

The candidate host-rule process explains why reported Swedish permission authorises a new Cal location.
The candidate host-rule process explains demands to clear additions and participants' reported risk that unpermitted builds are deleted.
The candidate envoy role is visible in a member relaying permission from Swedish Discord diplomacy into two Berkeley discussions.
The opening member combines proposing the mark with calling others, so the local start and recruitment are one turn.
A call is followed by a guideline request answered with a work report and coordinates, supporting a local sequence without measuring recruitment effects.
The restart proposal receives a bare report of starting the yellow C, supporting a visible acceptance without establishing an obligation for every reader.
The recruitment call and sticky promise do not establish a flood or show that flooding caused containment.
Treat a template as settling design only when final acceptance is evidenced, because provisional guides here coexist with corrections and an explicitly organic design.
The explicit instruction that the logo now needs defending and maintaining supports a local shift from construction to upkeep.
Infer adopted automation only with evidence of execution, because defence pressure and a script appeal here establish neither script use nor its effectiveness.
Apply maintenance-to-negotiation as one route rather than a necessary order, because host permission is also sought and relayed during restarting before the explicit upkeep instruction.
Extending agreements into room-wide restraint requires member compliance, which remains contested when a builder refuses entreaties and accepts possible deletion.
Infer help exchanged under strain only when aid is accepted or delivered, because a request here is refused for lack of spare pixels.
The permission discussion produces an explicit expectation of defending the host in return for space, with delivery of that help unverified.
A proposed truce and an expectation of reciprocal help do not establish coalition entry caused by maintenance pressure.
The opening recruitment call precedes a rival-logo takeover proposal, supporting sequence without identifying recruitment as the proposal's cause.
The strike proposal receives a direct refusal explaining the danger of antagonising the host.
The rival-replacement proposal receives redirection toward the existing Cal effort and a relayed permission agreement.
The coded attack-and-rebuttal exchange does not show a subsequent contest carried on through interaction with the rival room.
One proposal explicitly couples judging the corner war unwinnable with restarting the logo elsewhere.
Completion reports give members a finished mark to celebrate and credit collectively.
Treat celebration and final-survival reporting as sequence unless a passage attributes preservation activity to celebration.
A final-survival report followed by college advice supplies no test of a record causing decisions to preserve the temporary collective.
Permission dissent does not establish a dispute over authority to commit all placers, leaving the tentative arrow's endpoint unobserved.
Reported host permission supplies an authorised location for restarting construction rather than arising only after an established mark needs upkeep.
A final-result thread becomes a setting for welcoming an existing newcomer without evidence that canvas visibility recruited that person.
A welcomed newcomer receives practical cost advice that can favour another university over membership at the host institution.
A result-thread cheer receives a welcome and thanks, establishing a local transition into belonging without proving canvas-driven recruitment.
